title: Alien Word Sort
statement:
Decide whether a list of words is already sorted according to a supplied alphabet order.

Contract
- `words` and `order` are non-null. `words` may be empty, and every word is non-null.
- `order` contains each character that appears in `words` exactly once. Characters not present in the words may also appear in `order`.
- Compare adjacent words lexicographically using the rank from `order`. If one word is a prefix of the other, the shorter word comes first.
- Return `true` when every adjacent pair is in nondecreasing order; otherwise return `false`. Do not mutate `words`.

Examples
- `isSorted(new String[]{"app", "apple"}, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz")` returns `true`.
- `isSorted(new String[]{"apple", "app"}, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz")` returns `false` because the longer prefix word came first.
- `isSorted(new String[]{"zen", "zip"}, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz")` returns `true`.
hints: Write a helper that compares two words under the custom ranks.
The first different character decides the pair; only if none differ does length matter.
Build a rank table once, then check each adjacent pair. Intended complexity: O(total characters) time and O(1) space for a fixed-size rank table.
inputSyntax: Input: words as a bracketed list followed by order, for example: [app, apple] abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
